# Third-party notices for `vendor/hydra-synth.js`

`vendor/hydra-synth.js` is the **unmodified** browser build (`dist/hydra-synth.js`) of
[hydra-synth](https://github.com/ojack/hydra-synth) **v1.4.0** by Olivia Jack (ojack),
licensed under the **GNU AGPL-3.0** (full text: `LICENSE-hydra-synth`, identical to the repo-root `LICENSE`).

Corresponding source for that file: https://github.com/ojack/hydra-synth (tag/version 1.4.0, also on npm as `hydra-synth@1.4.0`).
To verify the vendored file is unmodified: `npm install --no-save hydra-synth@1.4.0` then compare
`node_modules/hydra-synth/dist/hydra-synth.js` with `vendor/hydra-synth.js` (they are byte-identical).

The browserify bundle also contains the following third-party packages. Their licenses are reproduced below
(contact e-mail addresses in the upstream license files are omitted here; the copyright holder names are unchanged).
The `process` shim embedded by browserify (`process/browser.js`) is MIT-licensed code by Roman Shtylman and Defunctzombie.
